title: These seal great!
text: These seal great!. I much prefer glass for storing my food in.  I've never felt comfortable with plastic, especially with hot food.  Toxins in the plastic concern me.  I would give these 5 stars, but they are hard to snap all sides closed and a couple of the flaps snapped off.

product_metadata.title: Lock&Lock Boroseal, Borosilicate Glass, 8-Piece Set/4-Containers
features: Includes a LLG841 (3.1-cup / 6.6x6.6x2.8in), a LLG871 (5.4-cup / 7.9x7.9x3.1in), and 2 of LLG211 (1.8-cup / 5.4x5.4x2.4in)
Excellent airtightness with the 4-side locking system keeps food fresh
Heat-resistant glass can withstand sudden change in temperature
Resists stains and odors for lifetime of clarity
Safe for use in microwave and oven (without lid), freezer, refrigerator, and dishwasher
description: Lock&Lock borosilicate glass is unlike any other. Heat resistant and airtight (on select models with four locking system). It uses material that contains strong heat resistant properties which could withstand sudden change in temperature. Plastic lids are BPA free. Our heat-resistant glass is produced in temperatures above 2700°F which makes it harder to manufacture, but safer to use. LOCK&LOCK BOROSEAL thermal shock strength is 250°F. Our borosilicate glass can be used not only in a refrigerator, a microwave, and a dishwasher, but also in a 750°F conventional oven. Unlike normal or tempered glass, if Lock&Lock Boroseal gets broken by physical shock, it doesn't break into numerous fragments and scatter. Therefore, it is safer and more suitable for you and your family. Cook in the oven with Lock&Lock glass or use it as bakeware (without lid). Microwave safe (without lid). It is salt and oxidation resistant and stain and odor resistant. Lock&Lock is so versatile you can go from oven to table at once and freezer to microwave at once. No more washing so many dirty dishes. -Set Dimension Information SKU Quantity Capacity Dimension LLG211 2EA 1.8-Cup/15.2 Fl. Oz 5.4 by 5.4 by 2.4in LLG841 1EA 3.1-Cup/25.7Fl.
